transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve just… been feeling really low for the past few weeks. Like there’s this heavy sadness on me most of the day. I can still get through work and smile at patients, but inside it feels like I’m barely holding it together.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you normally like to do?
Not really. I used to paint after work, or go to yoga… sometimes salsa. Lately I just go home and sit on the couch. I don’t really answer texts either. It just feels like too much effort.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I’m not really sure… I guess my sleep hasn’t been great, but I haven’t been keeping track or anything.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things that usually bring you pleasure?

Yeah… I think so. After my shifts I used to paint, or go to yoga or salsa to kind of unwind. Lately I just go home and sit on the couch. I don’t really text people back either… it just doesn’t feel worth the effort.
Do you feel guilty about anything?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but not about anything specific. It’s hard to explain.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?
Um… not exactly hurting myself. But I’ve had thoughts like… I wish I just wouldn’t wake up. I don’t have a plan or anything, but it scared me enough that I mentioned it at my prenatal appointment.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

I’m not sure about the number, exactly. I just… haven’t had much of an appetite. I know I’m supposed to eat regularly, but some days I get halfway through a shift and realize I’ve only had coffee or crackers.
How many weeks have you been feeling this low?
About three weeks, I think… since not long after I found out I was pregnant.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or the opposite, feeling restless and agitated?
Yeah… more slowed down, I guess. Everything feels like I’m moving through syrup. Even at the clinic, just getting wound supplies together or finishing charting takes me longer than it should.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts or heard voices that others don't hear?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or anything like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience any pleasure at all, even for a moment?

Not… completely, I guess. But most things don’t do much for me lately. After work I used to paint, or go to yoga or salsa just to unwind, and now I mostly just go home and sit on the couch. I ignore texts. It all feels like too much effort.
Do you feel like these feelings of sadness are interfering with your ability to care for yourself or your pregnancy?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still getting to work, but I’m not keeping up like I should. My supervisor’s noticed my charting isn’t always finished. And outside of that, I’ve been kind of pulling away from friends and the things that usually help me stay okay.
Are there any activities that you still find somewhat enjoyable, even if it's not as much as before?

A little, maybe… but not like before. I used to paint after shifts, or go to yoga or salsa to clear my head. Lately I mostly just go home and sit on the couch. Even answering texts feels like too much.
Do you feel like these feelings of sadness are worse in the morning or more consistent throughout the day?

It’s… mostly there through the day. I don’t think it’s just mornings. It’s like this heavy sadness sitting on me almost all day, even when I’m at work trying to smile and act normal. Inside I just feel like I’m barely keeping it together.
Do you feel like you're unable to find pleasure in anything at all, even small things like a favorite meal or a beautiful day?

Not… completely nothing, I guess. But most things don’t really feel worth it right now. After work I used to paint or go to yoga, sometimes salsa, and now I just go home and sit on the couch. I don’t even answer texts half the time.
Do you feel like these feelings of sadness are getting worse over time?

Yeah… I think so. For the past few weeks it’s felt heavier, like this sad pressure that’s there most of the day. I can still smile at work and get through it, but inside it feels like I’m barely holding it together.
Would you say that these feelings of sadness are making it hard for you to function at all, or are you still able to get by, even if it's a struggle?

I’m still getting by, I guess. I’m making it to work, but… not as well. My supervisor’s already noticed some of my charting isn’t finished. And outside of work I’ve kind of pulled away from people and stopped doing the things that usually keep me steady.
Would you say these feelings of sadness are interfering with your daily life most of the time?

Yeah… most days, I think. I’m still going to work, but I’m slipping on things, like my charting, and my supervisor noticed. And I’ve been… keeping to myself more. Not really seeing friends or doing the stuff that usually helps.
Do you feel like these feelings of sadness are making it hard for you to function most of the time?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I’m still showing up to work, but I’m not really keeping up like I should. My supervisor noticed my charting wasn’t done, and outside of work I’ve mostly just been avoiding people and not doing the things that usually help me stay okay.
Would you say that most days you are unable to carry out even the simplest daily activities because of your low mood?

No… not the simplest things, I guess. I’m still making it to work. It’s just harder, and I’m not keeping up like I should—my supervisor noticed my charting wasn’t finished. And I’ve been kind of pulling away from friends and the things that usually help me stay steady.
